paper_title: Search for galactic axions with a high-Q dielectric cavity
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of FIG. 8
notes: QUAX-agamma haloscope with high-Q (~3e5 loaded) dielectric cavity in 8 T field at ~4.5 K, probing axion mass window 42.8210-42.8223 ueV (10.35337-10.35345 GHz). Reference best upper limit g_agamma < 0.731e-13 GeV^-1 at 90% CL (text also quotes 0.729e-13 in the intro). No table of per-mass limit values; the two data points encode the quoted best limit spanning the stated 1.32 neV-wide mass window (limit degrades toward window edges per Fig. 8).
